help.description: Unofficial tool that moves LangChain 0.x imports to langchain 1.x (langchain-classic). The move table is computed from the real 0.3 and 1.x packages; nothing is sent over the network.
help.epilog:
Exit codes: 0 nothing to do, 1 fixable items or errors found, 2 usage error.
Start with:  langchain-v1-migrate check .   then   langchain-v1-migrate fix . --write
help.lang: output language: en or ko (default: LANGCHAIN_V1_MIGRATE_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
help.paths: files or folders to scan (default: current folder)
help.exclude: glob to skip while walking folders (repeatable)
help.target: classic: use langchain_classic paths as the official guide does (default); direct: follow re-export shims to langchain_community / langchain_core / langchain_text_splitters
help.table: use a move table written by the 'table' command instead of the bundled one
help.check: report what needs to change, without changing any file
help.strict: also exit 1 when there are warnings
help.fix: rewrite imports and dependency files (prints a diff unless --write is given)
help.write: apply the changes to the files
help.no_deps: do not touch requirements.txt, pyproject.toml or notebook %%pip lines
help.lookup: show where one 0.3 module or name went in 1.x
help.name: dotted name, e.g. langchain.chains.LLMChain or langchain.chains
help.table_cmd: compute a move table from two site-packages folders (nothing is imported)
help.to_site: site-packages folder containing langchain 1.x and langchain-classic
help.community_site: optional site-packages folder with langchain-community; lets the table mark re-exports whose target no longer exists
help.computed_on: date to record in the table metadata (keeps output reproducible)
error.path: path does not exist: {path}. Check the spelling or run from the project folder.
error.table: cannot compute the table: {detail}. Point --from-site/--to-site at site-packages folders that contain the packages.
report.summary: Summary: {files} file(s), {fixable} fixable, {errors} error(s), {warnings} warning(s), {info} info
fix.preview: Preview only: {count} file(s) would change. Add --write to apply.
lookup.unknown: {name}: not a langchain 0.3 module or name. Use the full dotted path, e.g. langchain.chains.LLMChain.
lookup.gone_module: module {module} is not in langchain 1.x or langchain-classic
lookup.hint: replace it by hand (for langchain.pydantic_v1 import pydantic directly)
lookup.gone_name: {name} does not exist in {module} or its langchain-classic counterpart
lookup.dead: warning: langchain-community no longer defines this name (usually moved to a provider package such as langchain-anthropic)
table.counts: modules: {move} moved to langchain_classic, {partial} partly kept ({names} names moved), {gone} gone, {keep} unchanged
msg.LCM003: '{name}' is not in {module} or its langchain-classic counterpart; remove or replace it by hand
msg.LCM004: module {module} is not in langchain 1.x or langchain-classic; replace it by hand (for pydantic_v1 import pydantic directly)
msg.LCM005.bare: 'import {module}' without an alias is not rewritten because attribute uses would break; use 'from ... import' or add an alias
msg.LCM005.star: 'from {module} import *' is not rewritten: its names are split between langchain and langchain-classic; list the names explicitly
msg.LCM006: {names} re-exported by langchain-classic from langchain-community; install langchain-classic[community] or use --target direct
msg.LCM006.dead: {names} re-exported by langchain-classic from langchain-community, but langchain-community no longer defines it (usually moved to a provider package such as langchain-anthropic); the import will fail until you switch to that package
msg.LCM007: {module} needs sqlalchemy[asyncio] (SQLAlchemy 2.1 does not install greenlet by default)
msg.LCM008: hub is deprecated in langchain-classic since 1.0.6 and scheduled for removal in 2.0.0 ("Use the LangSmith SDK instead")
msg.LCM009: {name} still works through langchain-classic but is a legacy API; the v1 way is LCEL / langchain.agents.create_agent (see the migration guide)
msg.LCM009.react: create_react_agent moved: use langchain.agents.create_agent (prompt= is now system_prompt=); see https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/migrate/langchain-v1
msg.LCM010: cell magic (%%...) cell skipped: it is not Python
msg.LCM012.pin: {spec} keeps langchain on 0.x, but langchain-classic 1.x needs langchain-core 1.x; upgrade or drop the pin
msg.LCM012.python: requires-python '{spec}' allows Python older than 3.10; langchain-classic needs 3.10+ (langchain 1.5 needs 3.11+)
msg.LCM013.pipmanual: add these packages to your install cell by hand: {packages}
msg.LCM013.hash: file uses --hash pins, so it was not edited; add by hand and re-compile: {packages}
help.help: show this help message and exit
